notes.title: Keystore Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921448/41ba52323d4151c09aa761b2ad2cc2e997069d2d.jpg[/img]
Fan art by Vtuber Kororo (コロ炉)



hello.
new update for you.

1. we have a repository on the first floor of the 'Origin' building.
You can store your keys in this storage.
Of course, you can still play without using the storage.

2. Fixed a bug where Henry on the 9th floor kept making balloons.


This is an upcoming update.

1. The Japanese translation issue has been pointed out and we will be hiring a full-time translator as soon as the sales are settled. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your interest. 

2. Hidden features of the camera will be added. It will help you find the key.

The bugs mentioned in the reviews are being fixed sequentially after confirmation.

(May Content Update) 4th Floor Update
The locked fourth floor is a room that maximizes the sense of dread. It won't be easy to get to, but you should be able to clear it. We'll also be updating the achievements related to the fourth floor.
This is a free update, of course.

Thank you.

notes.title: Update to add more languages
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921448/2fd39093ad9e49579f08a823ae3ccd31f766c740.jpg[/img]

hello.
11F new update content.

-What's new in this update

1. Chinese, Russian, and German languages have been added.

2. The background music in Henry's room on the 9th floor has been changed.

3. fix achievement errors

i will continue to work on fixes and updates.
Thank you for playing my game. 
It is my pleasure to see you have fun playing the game.

notes.title: April 20 Patch
notes.content:
April 20 Patch

1. Reduced Hans' spawn time and increased his stamina.
2. When you die on the 9th floor, you now start on the 9th floor.
3. Fixed some Japanese translation errors.
4. Removed a pair of doors on the 8th floor.
5. Thank you very much...

As a one-man development team... I think there was a lot of lack of testing.
I shouldn't be doing user testing when I'm selling it for money...
Still, I will fix it as soon as possible and update the content if possible.
Thank you for spending your valuable time and money to play and for your reviews.

Upcoming patches

1. create a gimmick to estimate key positions
2. sound adjustments
3. fix mouse sensitivity bug (hotfix ASAP)

Have a great weekend. Bye



Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: 11F released
notes.content:
'11F' has been released.
A building that doesn't have an 11th floor, but has 11 floors. Avoid the strange ghosts and climb to the 11th floor.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921448/5c1101166ae56a9c428029eec1db0057ed99e2c9.png[/img]

Those who downloaded the game in advance should be able to play normally after patching the game.
We apologize for the inconvenience.
We will continue to work on additional achievements, localization, and game updates.
Thank you for everything.

notes.title: 11F is coming soon.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921448/fb5b4f0994a6cd17a583b8e96b00287a5e2e35dc.png[/img]


Hello. I'm Sangwon Kim, a developer.
'11F' was originally scheduled to be released on the 17th, but has been pushed back to the 19th.
We apologize for the delay. We will do our best to reward you with a great game.
Thank you for your patience.
Have a nice day.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921448/56842bf7618385a07c23625cbdb6e8fe3cd1dcfe.png[/img]


Localization Additional Notice

We are working on adding more localization languages.
The current plan is to add languages in the order in which games are added to the wishlist.
We want to make sure that you have fun playing the game.
